definitions.explanation: A person who reads a great deal and enjoys it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{読書家|どくしょか}だ。
examples.english: My father is an avid reader.

examples.japanese: {読書家|どくしょか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{本|ほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{勧|すす}めて→勧める：02120_susumeru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: A friend who reads a lot recommended a book to me.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧な{読書家|どくしょか}で、⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{本棚|ほんだな}→本棚：04489_hondana⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{埋|う}まっていた→埋まる：01897_umaru⟧。
examples.english: My grandmother was a tremendous reader, and every wall of her house was covered with bookshelves.

notes:
Praising or neutral. ⟦{家|か}→〜家：28339_ka⟧ here is the suffix for a person with a strong habit or trait, as in ⟦{勉強家|べんきょうか}→勉強家：32687_benkyouka⟧ and ⟦{努力家|どりょくか}→努力家：22284_doryokuka⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{大|だい}→大〜：32357_dai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{読書家|どくしょか}: a great reader
- {読書家|どくしょか}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{知|し}られる→知る：00458_shiru⟧: to be known as a great reader

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {本|ほん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{虫|むし}→虫：02262_mushi⟧: bookworm — more playful
